{{Top|leg}}
'''Grav-cars''', also called '''lift-cars''', were used on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] around [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]] for personal transportation. The [[Palpatine Counter-Insurgency Front]] leader [[Kirtan Loor]] owned a grav-car with darkened windows that allowed him a degree of dark security for spying.
